verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration platform, so a natural-language command interface is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows a guided intake flow, questionnaires and calculators, plus a generic mention of 'AI workflows'. Nothing documents operating the product through natural-language commands, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
